fields.Name: IT05 - RecordProcessExecutor Facade
fields.Description: Exercises the RecordProcessExecutor facade above the substrate (deterministic, no model calls). A real MJ: Record Processes definition with a 0-row Filter scope (fully deterministic, zero side effects) is resolved + run, and the persisted MJ: Process Runs row must be Completed, linked back via RecordProcessID, and reflect SourceType=Filter with 0 rows processed. RPF1 runs it via executor.Run(definition); RPF2 via executor.RunByID(id) (the load-by-id entry point). The bundle creates + tears down its own Record Process + ProcessRun fixtures.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: executor.Run and executor.RunByID each persist a Completed ProcessRun linked to the Record Process, SourceType=Filter, 0 rows processed.
